description: This is a Java service class 'DriverService' in a Spring Boot project. It provides methods to retrieve driver users from the UserRepository, including getting all drivers and fetching a driver by ID.

classes.name: DriverService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling logic related to driver users, including retrieving all drivers and fetching a driver by ID.

methods.name: getAllDrivers
methods.description: Returns a list of users filtered to include only those with the DRIVERS role.

methods.name: getDriverById
methods.description: Fetches a user by their unique ID, returns null if not found.
